thread:
deploy-bot: starting rollout for release v2.3.7 -> enabling feature flag `prefer-new-batcher` with staged ramp. Canary: us-west-2. Window: 00:30-02:00 UTC. Plan: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% in 30m increments, 10m observation between steps. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-rollout-v2.3.7 :rocket:

alex: ack. quick Q — can we pin the llm-router model version before the 5% step? want deterministic canary results.

maria: yes, please pin. use `deployctl pin service=llm-router version=2026-03-20-3` — that will lock traffic to that model variant for the duration.

sam: rollback criteria I propose: error_rate (5m) > 1.5% OR p95 latency increase >200ms vs baseline OR request queue_depth > 3x usual. if any hit, retract to previous flag state and drain to 0% immediately, then investigate.

jin: +1 on metrics. i'll add dashboards and set alerts: llmroute.error_rate, llmroute.p95_latency, llmroute.queue_depth, gpu.utilization. also enable a short debug sampling (1%) for the canary to capture traces.

maria: also recommend a KV-prefetch/warmup run for the pinned model to avoid cold-kv spikes. script: 
```
./scripts/warm_kv.sh --model 2026-03-20-3 --prefix-file telemetry/top-prefixes.txt --concurrency 8
```
run ~10m before the first 5% step.

alex: i'll kick the warmup at T-10m. also lowering max_batch_delay to 6ms in us-west-2 during canary to reduce latency variance. config snippet: `batcher.max_delay_ms=6`

sam: add a short note in release notes: "Enabled prefer-new-batcher FF (staged), pinned llm-router=2026-03-20-3, ran KV warmup prior to canary." i'll create the PR.

ops-bot: scheduled rollout created: rollout_id=rl-20260320-77. auto-retract policy attached (thresholds from sam). will post status updates in this thread.

jin: quick checklist for monitoring hooks: 1) create temporary alert for p95>baseline+120ms to give early warning 2) enable trace sampling 3) watch for worker OOM logs `llm-router` namespace.

maria: one more ops safety: set deploybot soft-lock to prevent other flag changes in the same service during the window: `deployctl lock service=llm-router window=00:30-02:00UTC`

alex: done. lock applied.

sam: if we need an immediate rollback, use `deployctl ff set prefer-new-batcher=0% --force` and then `deployctl unpin service=llm-router` after we verify stability. include the incident ticket link in the postmortem.

deploy-bot: rollout will start at scheduled time. posting a preflight summary: pinned=2026-03-20-3, warmup=scheduled, canary_region=us-west-2, steps=[5%,20%,100%], obs=10m. tagging @maria @alex @sam @jin for visibility. :white_check_mark:

alex: ack, I'll be on watch for the first two steps.

maria: ack — i'll monitor KV error patterns and warmup logs.

sam: i'll stand by to cut to 0% if alerts fire.

ops-bot: preflight check passed (ci, smoke tests, infra health). ready to proceed.

deploy-bot: starting warmup in 5m and will announce when warmup finishes.

maria: warmup finished — top prefixes_cached=98%. handing over to deploy-bot to begin 5% canary.

deploy-bot: 5% canary started at 1819002560. continuing observation window.
